sentences.en: Legal history can now be followed in a continuous series of law reports, beginning with Keilway, Staunford and Dyer, and going on.

sentences.en: This may represent sediment supplied by cliff erosion being entrained by the westward flowing recirculating eddy (Dyer, 1971 ).

sentences.en: Baby farmer Amelia Dyer is set to face the hangman 's noose for the murder of a baby.

sentences.en: Anyway, the sheep, like Dyer, look to be seeking oblivion.

sentences.en: When Father Dyer arrived in the area, he decided to earn his living by traveling from town to town on his snowshoes, delivering the mail, along with the word of God.

sentences.en: John Dyer & Company specializes in uniquely cut gemstones.

sentences.en: Dr. Gwen Dyer wrote a comprehensive article on the authoritative parenting style and its outcomes for the website Parenting Science.

sentences.en: The clearest result of this seems to be, according to Dr. Dyer's article in Parenting Science, more popular and happier children.
sentences.vi: Kết quả rõ ràng nhất của điều này dường như là, theo bài báo của Tiến sĩ Dyer trên tạp chí Parenting Science, những đứa trẻ phổ biến hơn và hạnh phúc hơn.
